source.description: A swirling column of ochre sand with a humanoid torso, sandstone fists and a glowing amber core, dust spiraling continuously upward, small rocks orbiting the vortex. Seamless loop.

The swirling sand elemental with sandstone fists attacks — it gathers the vortex tighter, then slams both massive stone fists forward toward the camera in a burst of sand, then disperses back into its swirling column.

_notes: 1-direction object, side-scroller view. Base sprite approved pre-session; idle+attack generated via v3, self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
